test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting around a round table facing the centre with equal distances between two neighbours. Gaurav is sitting second to the left of Yashvi. Sana is sitting third to the left of Aaliya. Danish is sitting to the immediate left of Aaliya. Varnit is sitting third to the left of Yashvi. Gaurav is sitting to the immediate right of Varnit. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Sana?
solution: Given: Six friends are sitting around a round table facing the centre with equal distances between two neighbours. 1) Gaurav is sitting second to the left of Yashvi. 2) Varnit is sitting third to the left of Yashvi. 3) Gaurav is sitting to the immediate right of Varnit.
